description: FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE-N(file-connector-name) — the national twin of EXCEPTION-FILE's optional file-connector-name argument (ISO §2023:15.29.4 r2), a COBOL-2023 addition (Annex E.3.3 item 26). Same connector-status semantics in the national repertoire. The no-argument base form is 2002; the argument form is gated below 2023.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EXCFAN.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "excfan.txt".
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(5).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 W PIC N(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE-N(F) TO W.
           DISPLAY W.
           STOP RUN.
